topic_title: 15 Dog Breeds That Get Along Best With Cats
intro: Bringing a dog into a home where cats already reign supreme can be a bit of a balancing act. Certain dog breeds naturally have a calmer demeanor and a lower prey drive, making them more likely to coexist peacefully with feline friends. These breeds tend to be sociable, patient, and adaptable, which are key qualities when sharing space with cats. Whether you’re looking for a playful companion or a gentle guardian, these 15 breeds are known for their amiable nature around cats, helping create a harmonious household where everyone feels comfortable and loved.

picks.description: The Belgian Shepherd is an intelligent and versatile herding dog that, while energetic, can be socialized effectively to live peacefully with cats. Their keen herding instincts might make them attentive to smaller animals, but with proper training, they learn to coexist calmly. These dogs are loyal and protective of their family, including feline members, making them a dependable companion in multi-pet households. Their medium size and alert nature ensure they can keep an eye on the household while respecting the boundaries of cats.
picks.best_for: Families seeking an intelligent and trainable dog that can adapt to homes with cats.
picks.quirky_fact: Belgian Shepherds come in four distinct varieties, each with unique coat types and colors.

picks.description: The Philippine Forest Dog is a native breed known for its adaptability and balanced temperament. This breed has a natural calmness and social intelligence that helps it adjust well to living with cats. Though they have a hunting background, their low prey drive and awareness allow them to share a household without stirring up trouble. Their medium size and alertness make them good companions who respect the space of smaller animals, including cats.
picks.best_for: Owners looking for a moderately active, alert dog with a calm disposition around cats.
picks.quirky_fact: The Philippine Forest Dog is sometimes called "asong gubat," which means "forest dog" in the local language.

picks.description: The Macedonian Shepherd Dog, also called Karaman, is a robust guardian breed known for its protective instincts and calm demeanor. While originally bred to guard livestock from predators, they tend to have a low prey drive when properly socialized. Their imposing stature doesn’t translate to aggression toward household cats; instead, they often adopt a gentle and watchful attitude. With patience and positive reinforcement, these dogs can become excellent companions to feline family members.
picks.best_for: Homes looking for a large, calm guardian dog that respects smaller animals.
picks.quirky_fact: The Karaman has been used for centuries to protect flocks from wolves and bears in North Macedonia.
